title: MED+250 production domain DNS TLS and route verification
summary: The production custom hostname resolved publicly and every required HTTPS marketplace route passed the live deployment verifier.

checks.name: Public DNS resolution
checks.detail: The configured production hostname resolved through public Cloudflare-proxied addresses.

checks.name: HTTPS and security headers
checks.detail: The live HTTPS origin returned the required transport, framing, content, permissions, referrer, and request-tracing headers.

checks.name: Worker route behavior
checks.detail: All seven required marketplace, catalogue, product, robots, sitemap, and manifest routes returned the expected live behavior.
